_experiment.description: Omega sample size sensitivity — B=100. The manifold distance d_W is a Monte Carlo estimate over B uniform samples from Omega=[0,255]^196. At B=100 the estimate is highly noisy: the search step may select a suboptimal weight to prune because the distance ranking is unreliable. Compare the sparsity curve against e02_omega_1000, e02_omega_10000 (baseline), and e02_omega_100000 to identify the minimum B for stable pruning decisions.
literature: Thesis ch_manifold: d_W(w,w') = E_{x~U(Omega)}[||F(w)(x) - F(w')(x)||^2] — the expectation is approximated by Monte Carlo; this experiment characterises the approximation error
